warmup.instruction: Start with an easy pace to gradually increase your heart rate.

cooldown.instruction: Gradually decrease your pace to allow your heart rate to return to normal.

coach_notes.insight: Focus on maintaining a steady effort during the work intervals. Monitor your heart rate closely to stay within the target zones.
coach_notes.safety_warning: Ensure you are hydrated and aware of your surroundings, especially during high-intensity efforts.
